title: Hannibal Lecter vs Will Graham Analyzed Like Chess | Hannibal

source_quality.source_metadata_note: Thirty ordinary public-player clips measured native 1920x1080; conformed without resize to 30fps. Nine selected conversations, authentic cast, no burned captions or broadcast watermark seen in reviewed frames. Five acquired 720p clips and broadcast-logo groups excluded. Original public clips are highly compressed and facial detail is softer than a disc master; accepted for this authorized long private YouTube candidate, not claimed maximum-source quality.

outro_summary: Hannibal turns concern into leverage, while Will keeps asking what their closeness costs. Therapy becomes a contest over who defines the truth. By the last dinner, the offer to escape sounds almost tender; the consequences do not. Nine exchanges, twenty-eight decisions, and absolutely no reason to trust the menu.
